LVRR.NOT_RUNNING: Start LVRR and connect the headset first.
LVRR.VIRTUAL_MONITOR_RETRYING: Couldn't add the virtual monitor yet, trying again
LVRR.KDE_SCREENCAST_HIDDEN: Plasma doesn't share the screens with LVRR
LVRR.KDE_SCREENCAST_HOWTO: Screens need the screen cast pop-up on the desktop, and virtual monitors aren't available. Link io.github.lvrr.wayvr.desktop into ~/.local/share/applications (see the README), then restart the LVRR desktop.

REASON.HEADSET_SLOW: The headset hasn't answered yet. It may still apply the new settings.
REASON.BUSY: The headset session didn't end. Quit LVRR on the headset and try again.
